title: Fox wearing a party hat
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Party hat -->
  <polygon points='50,8 38,38 62,38' fill='#FFD700' stroke='#FFA500' stroke-width='1'/>
  <polygon points='44,20 56,20 53,27 47,27' fill='#FF69B4'/>
  <polygon points='40,32 60,32 58,38 42,38' fill='#FF69B4'/>
  <!-- Hat pom-pom -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='8' r='4' fill='#FF4500'/>
  <!-- Hat base band -->
  <rect x='38' y='36' width='24' height='4' rx='1' fill='#FFA500'/>

  <!-- Fox ears -->
  <polygon points='22,42 30,22 42,38' fill='#FF8C00'/>
  <polygon points='26,38 30,28 36,37' fill='#FFB366'/>
  <polygon points='78,42 70,22 58,38' fill='#FF8C00'/>
  <polygon points='74,38 70,28 64,37' fill='#FFB366'/>

  <!-- Fox head -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='55' rx='26' ry='22' fill='#FF8C00'/>
  <!-- Cheek fluff -->
  <ellipse cx='28' cy='58' rx='10' ry='8' fill='#FFA64D'/>
  <ellipse cx='72' cy='58' rx='10' ry='8' fill='#FFA64D'/>

  <!-- White face marking -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='62' rx='16' ry='13' fill='#FFF5E0'/>

  <!-- Eyes -->
  <ellipse cx='40' cy='51' rx='5' ry='6' fill='#2E1B0E'/>
  <ellipse cx='60' cy='51' rx='5' ry='6' fill='#2E1B0E'/>
  <circle cx='42' cy='49' r='2' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  <circle cx='62' cy='49' r='2' fill='#FFFFFF'/>

  <!-- Nose -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='62' rx='4' ry='3' fill='#2E1B0E'/>
  <!-- Mouth -->
  <path d='M46,66 Q50,70 54,66' fill='none' stroke='#5C3A1E' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <!-- Whiskers -->
  <line x1='22' y1='60' x2='36' y2='63' stroke='#FFCC80' stroke-width='1'/>
  <line x1='22' y1='66' x2='36' y2='66' stroke='#FFCC80' stroke-width='1'/>
  <line x1='78' y1='60' x2='64' y2='63' stroke='#FFCC80' stroke-width='1'/>
  <line x1='78' y1='66' x2='64' y2='66' stroke='#FFCC80' stroke-width='1'/>

  <!-- Body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='85' rx='20' ry='14' fill='#FF8C00'/>
  <!-- Chest -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='85' rx='12' ry='10' fill='#FFF5E0'/>

  <!-- Paws -->
  <ellipse cx='36' cy='93' rx='6' ry='4' fill='#FFB366'/>
  <ellipse cx='64' cy='93' rx='6' ry='4' fill='#FFB366'/>

  <!-- Tail -->
  <path d='M70,82 Q88,76 86,64 Q84,56 78,60 Q82,70 72,76' fill='#FF8C00'/>
  <path d='M86,64 Q84,58 80,62 Q83,68 82,72' fill='#FFF5E0'/>
</svg>
